## Summary

I resolved ticket T-2005 by identifying that the nightly ledger-export cronjob was failing due to exceeding its `activeDeadlineSeconds` deadline of 3600 seconds (1 hour). The job logs showed it was processing 95 batches of ledger data but was being terminated by SIGTERM after exactly 1 hour while still on batch 69. The fix is to increase the `activeDeadlineSeconds` value in the CronJob specification to allow sufficient time for the job to complete all 95 batches, with a recommended setting of at least 5400 seconds (90 minutes).
